canonical_project: Khazna DXB3 Ibn Battuta data center
notes: Khazna announced DXB3 at Ibn Battuta, with DXB2 and DXB3 jointly totaling 43MW IT load; PeeringDB lists the facility at Ibn Battuta, Jebel Ali. DXB3 was planned to begin operations in Q1 2024, so status is treated as operational but individual MW was not disclosed.
